about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2021-03-23 election, from the day after the previous election (2020-03-02) to the day before the vote, newest first: 169 polls by 18 pollsters (18 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2020-12-23 (74 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/, with the same lists, blocs, agreements and result as data/2021-03.json; parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: Netanyahu bloc as calibration.json counts it for 2021: Likud, Shas, UTJ, Religious Zionism. Yamina (Bennett, uncommitted) is 'mid'. New Hope is anti-Netanyahu ('opp').
